description: Calibration (no recipe change), to set the keep rule. Using the existing internal salt / trial-seed plumbing, run the E038 tip recipe on dev seeds 3-12 outside the official command (10 trials, same code), and log per-seed accuracy and time. Nothing is kept from this run. The result replaces the 2-salt guesses with a 10-seed estimate of the recipe's true mean and per-seed std, and tests whether official seeds 0-2 are a favourable draw: salt-1 draws came in lower three times (E027, E034, E039).
